compilation.basis: 2f_view.png: overall 15000x8000 outer-wall-face dimension lines (x-run px428-1812=15000mm; y-run px345-1071=8000mm), matching gray wall-face pixel evidence. Top dimension chain 1950+3600+1889+[120gap]+1891+3600+1950=15000 shows a single partition at world x=7.5m for the top row (2 large rooms). Bottom dimension chain 2190+1200+360+360+1200+2190 (x2)=15000 shows partitions at world x=3.75,7.5,11.25 for the bottom row (4 small rooms). Left dimension 3000+400+1200+400+3000=8000 gives corridor interior between two 400mm walls at world y=3.0-5.0; wall thin-line evidence places representative corridor wall lines at pixel y=600(top) and y=798(bottom).
